runtime.initialSelection: The first enabled tab, unless a good-tab is marked selected or activeId is supplied
runtime.selection: activeId is a two-way model; tabActivated reports pointer and keyboard selection
runtime.content: Each good-tab projects its own panel content
runtime.overflow: Header arrows appear only when tabs do not fit; mouse dragging and touch swiping also scroll the tab row without activating a tab
runtime.accessibility: Tablist, tab, and tabpanel roles with ARIA relationships and arrow-key navigation
